title: Student Lesson Report – Lesson Classroom – Two lessons with distinct classrooms – Maps each row to its source classroom
description: AC 02.3 — CRUD/readback / Regression — Each lesson row displays the Classroom related to that exact Lesson.
preconditions:
- Centre Staff A is logged in to Salesforce with access to Student A.
- Student A has Lesson Tokyo 01 in the current academic year with Classroom Room A.
- Student A has Lesson Tokyo 02 in the current academic year with Classroom Room B.
steps_actions: 1. Centre Staff A opens Student A's Student Lesson Report.\n2. Centre Staff A reads the Lesson Classroom value for Lesson Tokyo 01.\n3. Centre Staff A reads the Lesson Classroom value for Lesson Tokyo 02.
steps_result: 1. The report opens with rows for Lesson Tokyo 01 and Lesson Tokyo 02.\n2. Lesson Tokyo 01 displays Room A in Lesson Classroom.\n3. Lesson Tokyo 02 displays Room B in Lesson Classroom.
steps_data: 1. Student = Student A\n2. Lesson Tokyo 01 → Room A\n3. Lesson Tokyo 02 → Room B
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object

title: Student Lesson Report – Student Session – Report row link – Opens the matching Student Session detail
description: AC 02.4 — Scenario / Regression — The Student Session link opens the exact Student Session represented by its report row.
preconditions:
- Centre Staff A is logged in to Salesforce with access to Student A.
- Student A has Lesson Tokyo 01 in the current academic year.
- Student Session SS-A01 links Student A to Lesson Tokyo 01.
steps_actions: 1. Centre Staff A opens Student A's Student Lesson Report.\n2. Centre Staff A selects the Student Session value in the Lesson Tokyo 01 row.\n3. Centre Staff A reads the Student and Lesson values on the destination page.
steps_result: 1. The report shows the Lesson Tokyo 01 row with Student Session SS-A01.\n2. Salesforce opens the detail page for Student Session SS-A01.\n3. The destination identifies Student A and Lesson Tokyo 01, matching the source report row.
steps_data: 1. Student Session = SS-A01\n2. Source row = Lesson Tokyo 01\n3. Student = Student A; Lesson = Lesson Tokyo 01
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object

title: Student Lesson Report – Student Session – Restricted detail – Does not reveal an inaccessible session
description: AC 02.4 — Permission Matrix / Negative — A restricted staff user cannot use a Student Session link to reveal unavailable session data.
preconditions:
- Centre Staff B is logged in to Salesforce with Osaka Center access only.
- Student Session SS-A01 belongs to Student A at Tokyo Center.
- A report route containing the SS-A01 link is available to Centre Staff B only through a stale bookmark or direct navigation attempt.
steps_actions: 1. Centre Staff B attempts to open Student Session SS-A01 through the report link or direct route.\n2. Centre Staff B reads the resulting page state.
steps_result: 1. Salesforce denies access or does not display the SS-A01 detail.\n2. The page does not reveal Student A's lesson, attendance, or Student Session values.
steps_data: 1. Staff location = Osaka Center; Session location = Tokyo Center\n2. Student Session = SS-A01
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object
